narrative: On the board. The centre of the loose leaf, in the old hand. The margin note is still at the side. The red bundle is apart and knotted.  The page stops before any call and before any drinking. On the board. The two lines, and empty paper under them. The stylus is poised. He does not write the next word yet. On the board. The same two lines. A space under them large enough for one word. The word is not there. The bundle is untouched.
